name: Failure

subjectOf.text: At their worst, DAOs produce ponzi schemes and rug pulls, and these failures damage the credibility and future of web3 as a whole, not just the individual project.
subjectOf.abstract: At their worst, DAOs result in ponzi schemes and rug pulls that undermine the future of web3 and associated upgrades for humanity.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, DAO Fallacies (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4067783

subjectOf.text: Fundraiser DAOs are structurally fragile because they typically lack incentives for meaningful community engagement, so they dissipate once the hype that created them fades.
subjectOf.abstract: Fundraiser DAOs are vulnerable in multiple ways. They often lack incentives for meaningful community engagement and tend to dissipate with the hype.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, DAO Fallacies (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4067783
scope_conditions: DAOs formed primarily to raise funds

subjectOf.text: The absence of proper decentralized governance built on non-fungible tokens is a key common denominator across DAO failures and rug pulls.
subjectOf.abstract: The lack of proper decentralized governance with non-fungible tokens is a key common denominator among DAO failures and rug pulls.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, DAO Fallacies (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4067783
